dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are those two stone tablets...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: Oh, those stones are from the Milleliths, too. They said Mommy and Daddy got them to put them up here for them.

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: But I can't read very well. There's so many words on them that I don't recognize...

dialogues.speaker: Childish Jiang
dialogues.text: But I guess if they're from Mommy and Daddy, they must be really important to them, right?
